statement: The pinned xpad consumer matches045e:0b12 as XboxOne-type with Share and Share-offset mappings, exposes Share as KEY_RECORD and decodes its extension bit.

applicability.scope: Consumer evidence only: xpad.c:134,1103,1989. This does not establish a raw GIP report for every firmware.
